nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Deep Retreat Pore-Clearing Clay Mask

avis.texte: Very disappointed. I bought this in store today and when I got home I opened it just for it to be half empty! What a rip off!
I'm in humidity right now and decided to test it. It works well for several days. My face is not as greasy even now and I used it about 4 days ago. I would say give it a try. Will buy again.
Love this face mask. Super disappointed in Benefit for selling half full brand new containers. For an expensive face mask too.
I bought this in store once opened it was half empty and they refused the return I was disappointed even tho I told them it was like this.

avis.titre: product itself is fine but poor packaging
avis.texte: got this item in store and when i opened it at home, it was half full.... kinda disappointing because it's such little quantity to begin with and not super cheap
I just opened to use for the first time and it's practically empty

Ive had large clogged and dirty pores since high school. This is the only product that has actually cleaned them. I will be repurchasing for the rest of my life. Seriously its that good. I wish i could load before and afters but the app wont allow me to.

that does nothing! After using this many times and sitting around with this uncomfortable drying clay on my face for 30 min. I've determined this does nothing. Very expensive clay that has now dried out and is unusable.
This really makes the pores on my nose look much better! If I hadn't gotten a sample, I never would have tied it on my late 50s skin. Since using the sample, I've repurchased twice. It's that good!
I have tried a lot of clay masks. This one is very effective to de-gunk pores.

So I was at ultra beauty yesterday and was explaining into the cells.Young lady that I do not like my pores and the blackheads and she recommended this product.So I tried it on and wow, hands down best thing.I have ever used it truly lights up.The spots when your face where your pores are.And truly pulls them out.It's like a black light on your face of all the pores where they're coming out.It truly works and I have sensitive skin and it is not bothering my skin at all.

i too was very disappointed with the fact that half this very small jar was empty. for the price it needs to be full. my daughter was disapointed in her half empty gift, and due to this i would not repurchase.

I got to try this product while I had a eye blow appointment and I liked the product. I decided to buy the mini as a start even though it was a bit expensive side on the price.When I opened at home,I was disappointed with how little the portion was.
so i went and used it as directed and my face looked the same. pores still look like they are full of gunk. will continue my aunt for a quality product

avis.titre: Works great but hate the smell
avis.texte: Id give this 5 out of 5 for working well, but 1 out 5 for scent. When I got a sample I thought maybe it was old, or something wrong with it. I then bought one and it smells the same. It does a good job, but I wish it had a different or better scent to it. Either way it works and will still buy again.

Giving this a low rating because the container was half empty. For the price I feel like that's pretty unacceptable. There are so a few uses in this container. as far as what the product does, it does visibly draw oil out of your pores.

After using for a few months, my pores are definitely less congested and my skin's apace overall has improved (granted, I've used other products in the mix) This alone has kept my pores so much less congested though, seriously. I have bigger pores and used to extract constantly, but barely give it a thought since using

I love this mask, but for how expensive it is, it's frustrating that the container comes half empty. It still lasts me a while since I use it once weekly, but both times I've ordered it, it's not nearly full.
Love this product for my oily skin, but for the $22 container to come not even half full is a let down.

avis.titre: it really cleans out your pores!!!
avis.texte: I had a sample of this I used it, left it on let it dry you can see hole pockets that the mask is drawing out the clogged pores as soon I washed the mask off my face I can see the immediate results after one use my pores are clean out, my face appeared to be brighter, it felt good and refreshed..
It's easy to access (from a tin jar), smells pleasant, and leaves my face feeling clean and fresh. It's a wee bit pricey, and dries up quickly, but all in all, works for me!

Used this and my skin went from feeling bumpy and needing a good exfoliation to baby smooth! I can immediately tell within minutes it was drawing oils out and I can SEE it! Did it get every single blackhead gone? noo. BUT it got most of them AND my skin isnt dry! Not even a little bit! My skin feels VERY clean and purified, I definitely would recommend. My thoughts of buying was I was gonna use it once, be like mehh and then return but ill happily keep using this! Hopefully the more I use it, it can get those stubborn blackheads loose☺️ & im VERY picky on smells, this barely has a smell and dosnt smell like perfume (thank God!!)

At first, I was super disappointed to see the package was half full (or half empty for those who see it the other way), but it was the mini size and I read later they fill them by volume in the regular size can. I didn't really care about that anymore after just one application. Holy Smokes! I rinsed it off to see that not only my pores were clearer than they had been for years but noticeably smaller. Also, the redness in my face was COMPLETELY GONE! That has NEVER happened!!! I was absolutely floored. I looked like my teenage self again....minus the acne. Yes, I not only highly recommend it but I will be ordering the regular size ASAP. This will be my weekly routine that I look forward to!

Love the masque, but beware — the purple permanently stains fabrics! It ruined three of my white washcloths, leaving ugly gray stains even after bleaching. :( BUT the masque is so good that I've just kept them to use every time I wash it off, and I always wear black. Really draws the gunk out ugly clogged pores, and isn't excessively drying as long as I moisturize well after washing it off. So I highly recommend it, as long as youre careful.
Bought this as it was recommended by Jen works great actually to good ! now my whole family is using it too!

I've had a hard time trying to manage the blackheads on my nose, they've been with me since I was 13/15 years old. I tried pore strips, exfoliating, charcoal, clay masks, blackhead pimple patches, and NOTHING has ripped them clean out like this. I applied in a T-shape: between the brows, down the entire nose, and a little clay goatee on my chin. I used to not remember (or bother) to take care of myself and my skin, so being able to yank up YEARS of gunk so I can start fresh is relieving. I'm beyond happy with my purchase, my nose is finally beautiful and clear!! No more strawberry nose!

This product is amazing! I've always hated how big my pores were. After just a few weeks, I've seen a huge difference in their size! I can't wait to continue to use this product and see an even greater improvement in my pores!!

Can confirm that I ordered the mini mask, and this is the size that appears half full. It is sold by volume and is approximately 30 mL as described, but is put in larger packaging than required. I will add another review once I've used it.
I like this product. After I use it my face feels cleaned deeply and I have a fresh face to work with.
The product has a beautiful color and can easily be applied but really did nothing for me. Just after a week of use the product was almost gone and with no significant changes.

My first time using a sample from itsy. As soon as I applied it, it started tingling and burning just a tiny bit but I could definitely feel it cleaning my pores & my face has been super oily, clogged and dirty this past week. It smells good, and it feels like it's doing some huge cleaning work on my face and every pore. I just took a warm shower also before applying so I know my pores were already opened so I applied it right away.

avis.titre: Got to try this at Ulta!
avis.texte: When I went to get my brows done at Ulta they had a sample, and we tried it on my nose. My pores are visibly smaller and even some blackheads are gone. I'm going to buy it with my next check. I'm so glad I got to try it.
Definitely see the bubbles formed. I agree with the others who say it seems disingenuous how it is filled, but i try to remember an oz is an oz.

avis.titre: ATTN big pore girlies!! Go get this ASAP
avis.texte: ohhhhh my goodness is this a life changing product!!! I deal with a crazy oily face, HUGE pores, and annoying blackheads all the time and this product is the only thing that makes it tolerable! This mask really helps my skin feel silky smooth and have a subtle glow.
Amazing product that lets you see exactly where the oils are mainly concentrated on your skin, clears them and makes your skin looks healthy afterwords!
It really help my skin, I see such a difference after using it!

Okay, I don't normally write reviews, but I figured I should for this product. I was researching different face masks to use, and landed on this based on what I read. It's affordable, clean, and is not harsh on my skin! I thoroughly enjoy using this as my skin always feels clean and smooth after. No weird chemical feelings either! It's easy to apply and you dont need to use a bunch. Also, yes the product may appear to be half full, but it is definitely an ounce of product. I was concerned about that, but it probably just got tilted at some point.

I can literally see the bottom of the tin immediately after opening. If this was $10, maybe. However, if you are spending nearly $30 for this, I expect there to be enough product for more than 2 facemasks. I wish I could get a refund. Also has a strong chemical smell upon opening.

Finally received my package yesterday love the packaging and the color however, for the price it's not worth it. It practically came empty. I would love to put a five star however there's not much for me to provide because it isn't enough product for me to give a good evaluation on it cause it's not gonna last me no more than a few days. If you truly care about your customer, you're gonna make sure it's at least full not empty. It's practically just smeared around a container so it looks like it's a lot of product but in reality it's so hollow that like I said it probably will last me no more than 10 days super disappointed even though it's a good product

I was looking for a good clay mask to add to my skincare routine and this is definitely it, after the first use my skin felt so soft, my pores were clear and skin looked brighter. However when i opened the tin i was disappointed because it was barely halfway full, Im not sure if it's because i got the mini one but next time i'll try the bigger tin instead

I came looking to see if anyone else had a problem with the smell. I've never had a bad experience with any of benefits products, they're some of my favorite, but this smells a bit of sewage. Maybe give it a whiff in a store before you buy.

avis.titre: The best facial mask I've ever used!
avis.texte: Not only is this the best mask I've ever used, but it's my overall favorite skincare product. It gives my face such a soft, smooth finish that my husband notices and will ask, "You used your mask stuff again, didn't you?" I've been buying it for a few years and have never received a less-than-full container. This is one of the few spendy beauty/skincare products I think are worth it.
When I put it on it was so comfortable and creamy.after 30 mins of wating best results!
I don't know why there are reviews saying the container is half empy. The one I received was full to the top.

I was so excited to use this mask I had gotten it as a sample and loved it so much I decided to splurge and get the full tin. I waited weeks to get it because its not cheap. I was so disappointed when I opened the tin. Not only is the tin already so small but its not even half way full I would say theres maybe a tablespoon of product in there. Paying that much for that little product is so dissapointing.

I first tried this product in my boxycharm box YEARS AGO, I just purchased and still love the product. If your super sensitive to smell then this product might not be for you. Also it does wonder for the sebaceous filaments on my nose! (Not black heads) try it out!
It amazes me how clean my pores are! i am mesmerized about the dirt coming out with the mask on!
Great for pores cleans them right . Removed white heads and prevents black heads
I love it i almost order something else but the employees recommended this to me but now i love it cause its help my pores away
I love seeing the change of the mask color as it dries and the bubbles/spots. A bit drying afterwards.

I received a sample with my last purchase. Applied it and immediately you can see the oil being extracted from your pores. And the best sfter removed my pores minimize my pores! So of course I purchased the full size.

I love this product because I don't have to worry about me having to sit in front of the mirror and having to pinch my face looking for blackheads. I just sit down, put product and wait for product to dry and I know blackheads are gone

Im in love with this mask. It cleaned my pores extremely well. I could tell a difference the minute I rinsed it off. Not only did it clean but my face was super soft. This one will definitely be used regularly in my routine.

I went into my local Ulta in desperate search for a detoxifying mask. I was close to purchasing one that was twice the cost of this one until a sales rep helped me out and recommended the Benefit one. I was hesitant because my face is sensitive, and I thought, "what the heck, I'll bring it back if it doesn't work out."I used it as soon as I got home. I had it on for about 30 minutes, and it's been a few hours since I removed it. My face is smooth, and my pours feel so clean! I cannot wait to see more results, but so far, so food!
pretty goof face mask does what it says, the effects are temporary but good for the price
pretty goof face mask does what it says, the effects are temporary but good for the price

I bought the 1 oz last year to before splurging on the 2.5 oz jar. After using the mask my face is softer and my pores smaller. My nose is my problem area for blackheads and this mask makes them disappear. I have read reviews where people say it's overpriced for a small amount, but less is more with application.

I first tried this while having my eyebrows shaped at our Ulta store. I immediately noticed an improvement with the pores on my nose. I bought the buy 1 get one free mini offer, and I have really enjoyed having this little product as part of my routine. I've used it on my husband, who has large, oily pores on his nose. It's done very well for him.
when the mask dries, it looks like it is removing the black heads. when you take it off, it shows to do not much. I will return it
So, the reason the amount of the product looks like it's half full is... it's only 1 oz and the tin is larger. So it appears like there is barely any product.

I recently bought this got teen daughter and myself. We both feel it works. We have only used it twice each but are excited to see results after a month or two. After washing it off pores are noticeable smaller

A little unsure how I feel about the product. The scent when putting it on is great, but it has such a foul smell when washing off; it's almost insufferable. Right after washing off, I feel like black/white heads are more noticeable, but the following day look better. You can tell it's working while it's on.

I'll be 70 years old this year & only recently started having "problems" with my skin. I used Deep Retreat for the first time today and was pleasantly surprised by how well it works. The pores on and around my nose are noticeably smaller. Can't wait to use it again next week!

I have never left a review but had to for this product. It is AMAZING. It truly minimizes my pore sizes. I have never been so happy. Areas of my skin I was insecure with cleared in seconds and stayed that way for the past few days.

Of course everyones skin is different, but as someone who has highly reactive skin that is easily sensitized this product has done me so well. It doesnt cause any reaction and truly does pull oils out and make my pores appear smaller. Love it.

I received this mask as a freebie and I am SO happy that I did! I instantly added the full size to my bag and will be purchasing ASAP! You can truly see the results with the mask on as the oil is pulled from your pores AND my pores were squeaky clean.

avis.titre: Does exactly what it says it does!
avis.texte: I always and only use the Deep Retreat and the Speedy smooth face masks I am addicted to these Pore-fessional masks! Benefit does it correctly always!! Love it so much ❤️ 💕 💖
I bought the mini on sale to try it and am very pleased after my first use. My skin felt amazing - tightened but not dried out. I would buy again.

Just got the tin, opened it and it is less than halfway full. I see other people have complained about this too. It is ridiculous to sell a product that isnt full. Use a smaller tin or something. The picture on the website shows it full too! What a joke.
I was ecstatic to use this for the first time upon reading the reviews, havent used a pore mask in awhile, and this made my face feel really clean
Insane lol look at my picture and you'll see how well it worked.
Cleared almost all of my blackheads on my nose and made my face super smooth!!
Cleared almost all of my blackheads on my nose and made my face super smooth!!
This is a truly good product, my only gripe is that the container is MAYBE half full. Disappointed.

I'm always a little skeptical about products that specialize in removing pores but I decided to give this a try. First time I used it and I immediately noticed a difference after. I'm on my third week of using this mask now and I'm obsessed.

I have to say, this is a mask that actually clears my blackheads. However, it doesnt pull them out like a pore strip. My pores are noticeably smaller and clearer. I use to use glam glow mud mask nut it would burn my sensitive skin. This still burns a bit after but nothing lotion cant fix.

I love this product and what it does for my skin but with the price tag I wanted to try other options to see if I could find something more budget friendly. Honestly, I spent more money trying (and hating) other products than if id just sucked it up and bought this agin when I ran out.

avis.titre: so far.. I REALLY liked it!!!
avis.texte: So after one use it made my skin feel like it was gently exfoliated as if I shaved / cleansed my face- so my skin felt smoother , as for the before and after for my pores I personally didn't notice much it looked like they smoothed out but I don't have any that are extremely noticeable but i definitely loved how it left my skin feeling fresh and deep cleansed! For the people struggling to remove the clay after 30 mins i recommend going in with warm water when rinsing!! Then after that go in with your cleanser and finish off with your skincare routine!! trust me your skin barrier will thank u.

avis.titre: Perfect for sensitive, mature, oily skin
avis.texte: Hi have very oily skin, I'm 42 and have rosacea. After 1 use, my skin is amazing. Stayed oil free ALL DAY.

This is the first clay mask ive ever used and i had higher expectations. This mask left my skin feeling smooth which would make you think that it cleared out your pores but when i looked closer in the mirror i can visibly see all my blackheads are still there that i can extract with a tool. Im not really sure what this mask is supposed to achieve if its not really flushing out your pores as it claims to.

I love this mask it feels so good and soothing! it does get hard and itchy when ready to wash off but it's never hurt my face and I have sensitive skin and break out easy. I have larger pores so I do see a different when using it, and I seem to glow more after using.
Just wow. Barley any product when I opened it, BARELY even half full, dont even wanna say half full because thats a lie, less than that. Wow benefit…
Makes your face feels so clean and pores looked smaller and cleaner! It is amazing to see the oil that was pulled out of your pores once the mask dries.

Recieved this as a deluxe sample for purchasing Benefit products! Snagged a full size because i liked it so muxh. First impressions: a little bit of product goes a long way. Definitely use this as a "zoning mask." If you're a see it to believe it type of girlie, you can watch it working as it dries. Pricepoint is pretty reasonable given this isnt something you should use everyday or all over.

I saw this clay mask and wanted to give it a try, some reviews say it minimizes pores and gets rid of black heads, I was exited to used but I just opened it and is not even half of the content. This product is a little price to get just a little bit. I think you should save your money and get a product that gives you all the content
This product broke me out right away and left my skin red. Definitely not for those with sensitive skin!

I was a bit annoyed to see the amount of product in the sample size though it was definitely enough to sell me on the full size. I have tried all sorts of products to clear my pores to no avail but with this little gem I saw major results after the first use!!! I wish I had taken before and afters but I didn't have much faith so I didn't bother. I estimate I will get 4-5 uses out of the sample and with the package rec being one use per week I find it a good deal. Will definitely purchase the full size before I run out of the mini.

I only use this when I know I will go into the shower. Taking this mask off is one of the most messy things I have to do and it's so inconvenient I rather have something that is easy to take off with water and I don't have to scrub my face so hard for.
This clay mask is great. I have oily skin and I can see it pull all of the oil out right before my eyes.
This mask is incredible, my face was so clear after. I recommend this to anybody with oily skin.

avis.titre: Just like the sample size, not worth the money
avis.texte: This came with like 2 tablespoons of product if that, less than half full. Don't waste your money!

I would recommend! I have dry/sensitive skin and I use this only once a week and I have seen so much improvement with a month. It has helped me not break out, brighten and smooth my skin. (I also have eczema, it doesn't bother it. I do have mine controlled so I have not had bad eczema on my face)
I bought this mask for my best friends birthday and she applied the mask. She called 20 minutes later and showed me that the mask left a red outline around her face where she applied it.

This is insane. The only thing that has helped me with sebaceous filaments, and I have tried everything. They arent gone completely, but 80% I would say. Pores are smaller as well. Just wayyyyy less congested. And I have only used it 3 times. This is unfortunatly worth the price.

I received this mask, as a sample, to try from the amazing, Rachelle, at the benefit brow bar. I loved the sample of it, definitely made me want to purchase the container. Try it out if you need a good pore clearing mask for once a week.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again!
avis.texte: This works real well on your pores, pretty much how the container states Really gives me some me time while wait for it to dry. Relax and enjoy!
Even if it works wonders, there is no way i will buy again. Maybe 2 tablespoons of product. Barely 1/4 full. Huge ripoff!

I bought a mini size to try ans it exceeded my expectations. Immediately after I removed it my skin had a nice glow and my pores that I thought were fine, looked great! After I removed the mask and the next day my skin was so soft. It's the mask I didn't know I needed.

I do like the product however I don't like that you get less than half a jar of it. There is barely anything in this small tin. There are so many clay masks out there that are prob better than this one and you get a full jar
Something about seeing the oils being lifted from your pores so satisfying it works. Its soft definitely helps your acne as well.

This mask is like a spa day for your skin, providing a pampering experience with noticeable results. If you're in search of a clay mask that goes beyond the surface, clearing out pores and revitalizing your skin, this is the one to try. I would more prefer this mask in summers. A true pore-perfecting gem!
THIS IS MY FAVORITE CLAY MASK AND WHILE IT IS EXPENSIVE IT WORKS SO WELL

Tried a sample of this at Ulta with low expectations for it, and I was surprised. My skin was instantly softer the next day. I bought the small container and use it 2x a week for the best results. When I use it consistently, my skin is softer and noticeably clearer of pimples and blackheads. I love how you can see the oil be drained out of your skin once the mask dries up! I think the recommended time to leave it on is 30 mins, but I like to leave it a bit longer. I notice my skin feels more delicious afterward with the extra time.

Maybe this is a complaint for Benefit, not Ulta. But the product container is half full. I've never seen that before. Usually jar masks are almost full when opened, with just a bit on the top. If you were able to see how little you get you wouldn't want it.
I have acne and large pores. This does not help with my acne, but as far as clearing my pores on nose, cheeks, and chin man it works!!!
Theres hardly any product, i had to double check it wasn't a free sample size. Theres some reviews that show a lot more product than I received. Really sad cause tge product is cool.

Ive had black heads on my nose for over a decade and this mask is the only one ive ever used that actually removed gunk from my nose!! First use and i could see the difference!! Cant wait to try again

Received this product and it is not as advertised! The container was only about 25% filled! On the pictures of the website it shows the container filled all the way to the top, this is a rip off! NOT COOL BENEFIT!
Already felt so good after my first use of this product. I love how my skin felt. Price is a BIT steep… BUT its worth trying it out. I have combination skin.
I did like the product. I think I have to use it daily for my skin. I've found better products that help me with my pores.
This works around my nose and t zone that has clogged pores. It always cleans up and tones that area.

avis.titre: works when the product doesn't dry out
avis.texte: it works good tightens face but I couldn't use it anymore because it turned to putty after a month so recommend if you buy buy the small one bevsusr it msy not be useable after a month. disappointing to say the least.

I am so disappointed in this product and entire line. It does absolutely nothing for you skin, it honestly makes it worse. Customer service refused to accept my return even though Product is almost full. The good reviews are 100% from paid influencers. Don't buy into the hype like I did. Embarrassing

avis.titre: Why is this product so small??
avis.texte: I am so upset and so turned off by the size of this product and to make matters worse it was only half way filled. I do not care if you don't need to use alot. Benefit should not be allowed to sell something that is only halfway full. I am extremely disappointed!!!!

I always had 2 tone skin and tried for years to figure it out. I finally paid for facials and nothing. My daughter brought this product and I flipped out at the price because she's o lying 14 yrs old. Well, this clay is a miracle. I never thought clogged pores were the issue. My 2 toned complexion is now even to tone and I am happy 😊

I saw the other comments about it not being full but i wanted to try anyway and its literally 1/4 full of product . You dont need a lot for the whole face but for 20$ i expected it at least 3/4 full , it feels good very cooling and the little dots are showing up so its working good. Smells just like clay.
This mask cleared my face better than any other mask I've ever tried. I love this mask and the benefit foam toner! Seriously the best!!!!
My skin feels so smooth and healthy after 1 use. i could see the blackheads being removed and definitely feel a huge difference in my pores before and after. this product really works!

avis.titre: Best "Instant" Pore Product, Fun to Watch While It Works
avis.texte: I got a trial size of this for my birthday reward. I used it before a rodeo to really freshen up my skin, and I still have plenty in the trial size jar. The mask is easy to wash off, it dries quickly, and it really does minimize your pores the best it can for an "instant" product (although it's not as good as a long term skincare routine). Most of all, it's fun to watch. The mask turns a darker color as it absorbs oil, so you can see the blackheads being removed over time. The darker it gets, the worse the clogging, so that's helpful to find your problem areas, too.
I'm not usually a mask user, but I really did like how my skin looked and felt after using it
I have combo skin and using this mask, especially around my t-zone, really helped clear out my pores and left my skin so clear!
Gets the gunk out and leaves my face feeling clean, not stripping. It's packaged well and is travel friendly.
Loved the consistency and the smell. Refined pores and no issue after with reactions!

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life
avis.texte: About 3 years ago I started using more face masks. I love that they were always more natural than more chemical laced products to remove redness and improve pores/blackheads. For the bulk of those years I used Lush products but not anymore. After one use I noticed a difference, its a month later and my pores are so much smaller and blackheads are almost all gone. I think I have found my forever product.
Great mask it absorbs all grease and leaves the skin feeling cleaner.

I've been having really bad, visible open pores and no matter how much I clean my skin with products they're full daily . I tried charcoal products but they were making my skin more oily afterwards. This product is wonderful, I didn't expect for my pores to disappear but I would say 50% of them are not visible and those big ones are 50%smaller so I'm very happy with results, however I use it 2-3 times a week , it does not make my skin more oily or doesnt dries it out! I don't really see pores when I put a make up on . The only thing I'm not happy with is the fact container is only a half full :(
Just opened it & it looks like ive already used it multiple times. Such little product for the amount that it is. Wont buy again.

I really enjoyed this mask, i have quite big black pores on my nose and this clay mask does miracles. I would not recommend to use it every day as it is a little bit drying, but I use it once a week and the difference is huge.

I suffer with oily skin so face masks like this are perfect for me, when applied it dries quite quickly and you can see the oils/ blackheads coming away. When removed skin was left feeling so soft and clean, I would definitely buy this!
Left my skin feeling clean and looking brighter. I have oily skin and this also reduced my oiliness, really happy with it and good to do every week for a skin reset
Felt nice, smelt amazing and easy to use, made my skin feel so soft and supple
Scent is light and pleasant You can actually see it working My pores look so much better Shouldn't be surprised since i love this brand

I love the actual mask itself and believe it's super refreshing and very light, what I hate is the fact it's not even full when you open it. . Talk about a product rip off. It was 1/4 full when I opened it.. not happy about that

avis.titre: Received as a free sample and definitely buying!!
avis.texte: Problem area is blackheads/pores on my nose. I used the free sample 2x so far & I'm sold! Will be purchasing. So many dots appear on my nose as it dries and I instantly see a difference in pore size and number of visible blackheads upon washing off.
This is super amazing leaves skin feeling fresh and rehydrated and helps with blackheads too.
It's so satisfyingly clean, i love the mask when it touches my face, so clean!

I just purchased this mask yesterday. I have sensitive, combination skin. I used it for the first time today and I absolutely LOVE it. I couldn't believe the amount of gunk that came out of my pores after just one use. I love that my skin didn't feel tight or dried out after rinsing it off. I will definitely be adding this into my weekly skincare routine! Super impressed!

Received this yesterday. Opened today, it was sealed. Jar is less than a quarter full. I pulled off the seal and shook it cuz all the product was on the side and this is how much is in the container. I uploaded pic. Ridiculous

I'm so disappointed because I do love this product but if it's not going to be full, it is absolutely NOT worth your money.

I just tried this pore-clearing mask this morning. I cleansed my face and dried it. I applied an even layer on my face and neck with a brush and waited the recommended 30 minutes. The mask dried and i could visibly see where the blackheads around my T-zone were being extracted. I removed the mask after 30 minutes with a warm wash cloth and my skin and pores looked beautiful. I immediately noticed a reduction in my pore size as well as fewer blackheads. This mask is a game changer and I am so glad I bought it. Thank you Benefit Cosmetics and Ulta.

I'm really impressed with the Porefessional Deep Retreat mask. It was smooth to apply and didn't take too long to dry. Once it has worked it's magic the areas where oil and dirt have been absorbed stay a darker purple colour, while the rest of the mask is a lighter purple. It's great to be able to see the areas where it's working! After application my skin was really smooth and my problem areas (chin and nose) looked noticeably clearer. Will be purchasing again and recommending.

I was a little nervous about trying a new product as I have used a different brand for years but my god this is god sent. Little goes a long way! And it really removes the pores you can see it working after the first 5 mins of applying. Excellent product

I have even had compliments on how even my skin tone is looking at the moment. To me it feels plumped and moisturised whilst also cleansed and clean.

I hate when i read comments and people say "im totally a believer now! It worked" because i often wonder if they're being honest. Well, I'm weiting to say that i bought this myself - not gifted from Benefit …gifted to myself by myself. I'd been trying to find something to get rid of the little blackheads on my nose. I've used the pore sucker machines (which is great to see all that junk out of your nose but a day or so later I would get a big pimple!) other masks, scrubs, et. Yup, I was cynical. But i did this last night as i took a long hot bath. When it dried, it didnt flake off or feel make your skin crack like the mud in a drought. And I wasn't itchy! I washed it off, then on with my skincare routine (face wash, toner, serum (eye and face) and moisturizer.) The next day I got ready for work and caught a glimpes of myself.. my skin was glowy. omg!! Pores were sooo much smaller and hardly any blackheads. Where did they go!? I can't wait to use again in a few days. So yea. It works amd works amazingly!

I don't normally write reviews for anything but when I tell you this mask is a life changer! Run, don't walk to get this and I mean it. I've struggled for years with so many sebaceous filaments peaking through my face in so many spots giving me so much texture and it looks bad and feels prickly. However, after just ONE USE a majority of it disappeared and just smoothed out. My face has never felt or looked this soft. It even calms my acne down quite a bit! It doesn't burn or anything which is amazing with all the benefits! My boyfriend kept mentioning how smooth my skin looked and felt. He said that my skin looked amazing and I 100% agree. My skin has never looked so smooth and radiant like this. I've tried a lot of things for my face to get rid of the filaments but nothing has worked as well as this has.
Great product! I can see results just after first use!! Highly recommended
